svg.aria-label: The work: agents at the surface, packets at the bottom.
svg.text: Agents at the surface, packets at the bottom.
L5 · AGENTS — WHAT PEOPLE TALK TO
Outbound voice agent at 1M+ calls a month in 10 Indian languages, with AI post-call analysis synced to client CRMs.
15+ chat agents across WhatsApp, Instagram, email & web · a 60K tickets/month email agent architected on AWS.
L3 · GATEWAY — WHAT KEEPS THEM HONEST
A self-hosted multi-provider LLM gateway — routing, fallback, per-customer cost tracking — under every agent.
One measured benchmarking pass over sample rates, VAD and providers cut voice cost 26% per minute.
L1 · PACKETS — WHERE THE REAL BUGS LIVE
~90% of calls failing in bursts, nothing in the logs — found a carrier's broken SIP-over-TCP framing in raw pcaps,
fixed it in the parser, shipped it in a public fork. Failure bursts: 90% → 0.
